points.description: States that empirical equations are derived from experiments / observed data (experimental or observational data/measurements), not from theory.
points.partial_credit: Half only if it refers to data or observation but imprecisely (e.g. 'based on practice' or 'from data' without experiments/observations named) — otherwise 0.

points.description: States that empirical equations have no mathematical (theoretical) proof or derivation behind them.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both elements: derived from experiments/observed data, AND no mathematical proof/theoretical derivation behind them. Each point is earned only if stated clearly; vague phrases like 'formula used in practice' or 'approximate equation' earn nothing. Any wrong statement (e.g. 'derived from theoretical principles' or 'mathematically proven') loses that point.
